title: Hitman: Blood Money
notes: Vault reads your save games (the Save folder in the game folder) and never touches the game.
Save once in each new mission (or use "save and continue" between missions) and the mission before it counts as finished.
Untested: Vault hasn't seen a Blood Money save yet, so if nothing pops after saving, send a test report.

testGuide.title: Play the first contract
testGuide.detail: Finish Death of a Showman and choose to save when the game offers between missions.

testGuide.title: Check the numbers
testGuide.detail: "Last save" should show the next mission, and "Death of a Showman" should pop.
